nodes.name: recovery.rs
nodes.summary: Detects and repairs a turn's message history when execution was interrupted mid-tool-call or mid-assistant-response, ensuring the LLM provider never sees a malformed history after a crash or forced stop.

nodes.name: detect_turn_interruption
nodes.summary: Scans the tail of a turn's message history to determine whether execution was interrupted mid-tool-call or mid-assistant-response, returning the classified InterruptionType.

nodes.name: repair_interrupted_history
nodes.summary: Rewrites an interrupted message history into a valid state the model can resume from, closing out dangling tool calls or truncating an unterminated assistant turn.

nodes.name: filter_unresolved_tool_uses
nodes.summary: Strips tool-call entries that never received a matching tool-result from the history, preventing malformed provider requests after a crash.

nodes.name: ensure_tool_result_pairing
nodes.summary: Validates and repairs tool_use/tool_result pairing across the message history, inserting synthetic results for any tool call left unanswered.

nodes.name: InterruptionType
nodes.summary: Enumerates the ways a turn can be left interrupted (a tool call awaiting its result, or an assistant message cut off mid-stream), driving the recovery repair logic.

nodes.name: scheduler.rs
nodes.summary: Implements DialogScheduler, a per-session async message queue that serializes turn and maintenance work through a single background worker task, tracking generation numbers and deduplicating by client message id.

nodes.name: panic_payload_to_string
nodes.summary: Converts a caught panic payload into a human-readable string for logging when the scheduler's worker task unwinds unexpectedly.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a DialogScheduler for a session with a bounded message channel of the given capacity.

nodes.name: ensure_initialized
nodes.summary: Lazily spawns the background WorkerTask loop the first time the scheduler is used for a session.

nodes.name: enqueue
nodes.summary: Pushes a scheduled turn/maintenance message onto the session's queue, deduplicating by client_message_id and returning the resulting queue position.

nodes.name: pending_count
nodes.summary: Returns the number of messages currently queued and not yet processed.

nodes.name: invalidate_pending
nodes.summary: Bumps the scheduler generation to invalidate all currently queued messages, used when a session is reset mid-flight.

nodes.name: is_processing
nodes.summary: Reports whether the worker task is actively processing any queued message.

nodes.name: is_turn_processing
nodes.summary: Reports whether the worker task is specifically mid-turn, as opposed to a maintenance message.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Snapshots the scheduler's current QueueStatus (pending count and processing state) for UI polling.

nodes.name: run
nodes.summary: The WorkerTask's main loop that pulls scheduled messages off the channel one at a time and drives their execution, broadcasting queue/idle status as it goes.

nodes.name: broadcast_idle_status
nodes.summary: Emits a UI event announcing the worker has drained its queue and gone idle.

nodes.name: ScheduledKind
nodes.summary: Distinguishes a queued message as a normal conversational turn versus a background maintenance task.

nodes.name: ScheduledMessage
nodes.summary: Represents one item queued for processing, carrying its kind, ids, generation stamp and executable payload closure.

nodes.name: QueueStatus
nodes.summary: Snapshot DTO reporting a session's pending message count and processing flag to the UI layer.

nodes.name: EnqueueResult
nodes.summary: Return value of enqueue() reporting the assigned message id, queue position, and whether it was a duplicate.

nodes.name: DialogScheduler
nodes.summary: Per-session async message queue that serializes turn and maintenance work through a single worker task, tracking generation and duplicate client message ids.

nodes.name: WorkerTask
nodes.summary: The background task backing a DialogScheduler, owning the receiver end of the channel and running the processing loop.

nodes.name: session_id.rs
nodes.summary: Utility functions for slugifying, deriving, versioning and de-duplicating stable session id strings from channel/chat identifiers.

nodes.name: slugify_segment
nodes.summary: Normalizes an arbitrary string into a filesystem/id-safe slug, falling back to a default when the input yields nothing usable.

nodes.name: os_session_id_base
nodes.summary: Derives the base, unversioned session id from a channel/chat identifier pair.

nodes.name: with_version
nodes.summary: Appends a version suffix to a base session id string.

nodes.name: next_version_for
nodes.summary: Scans existing session ids sharing a base to compute the next available version suffix, avoiding collisions.

nodes.name: title.rs
nodes.summary: Generates a short descriptive session title via a side-query LLM call, with a heuristic fallback and persistence onto the session record.

nodes.name: normalize_title
nodes.summary: Cleans up a raw LLM-generated title candidate, trimming quotes/whitespace and stray formatting into a display-ready string.

nodes.name: derive_title_fallback
nodes.summary: Produces a best-effort session title from the first user message when LLM title generation is unavailable or fails.

nodes.name: truncate_title
nodes.summary: Clips an overly long title to a display-safe character limit, adding an ellipsis when truncated.

nodes.name: generate_session_title
nodes.summary: Issues a side-query LLM call asking for a short descriptive title for the given conversation content.

nodes.name: generate_and_persist_session_title
nodes.summary: Generates a session title via LLM, falling back to a heuristic title, and persists it onto the session record.

nodes.name: background_reminder.rs
nodes.summary: Builds a system reminder message that summarizes still-running or newly-completed background jobs for injection into the next turn's prompt.

nodes.name: inlined_result_handles
nodes.summary: Extracts the set of background job handles whose results have already been inlined into the conversation, to avoid re-surfacing them.

nodes.name: build_background_jobs_reminder
nodes.summary: Builds a system reminder message summarizing still-running or newly-completed background jobs to inject into the next turn's prompt.

nodes.name: format_age
nodes.summary: Formats an elapsed-time-in-milliseconds value into a short human-readable age string for the reminder text.

nodes.name: entry.rs
nodes.summary: Entry point that turns a raw user TurnInput into a normalized, context-enriched message — extracting LSP/screenshot context and expanding skill slash commands — ready for the turn processor.

nodes.name: extract_screenshot_store
nodes.summary: Pulls the shared screenshot store handle out of the Tauri app state so it can be attached to a turn's context.

nodes.name: expand_skill_slash_command
nodes.summary: Detects a leading slash-command in the user's message and expands it into the referenced skill's full instructions before the turn is processed.

nodes.name: process_message
nodes.summary: Top-level entry point that turns a raw user TurnInput into a normalized, context-enriched message ready to be handed to the turn processor.

nodes.name: event_factory.rs
nodes.summary: Builds structured UI event payloads — assistant message, tool call and tool result events — consumed by the frontend event store.

nodes.name: build_assistant_message_event
nodes.summary: Constructs the UI event payload announcing a new assistant message chunk for a session.

nodes.name: build_tool_call_event
nodes.summary: Builds the structured event describing a tool invocation (id, name, display label, arguments, repo context) for the frontend.

nodes.name: build_tool_result_event
nodes.summary: Builds the structured event carrying a tool's completed result and any UI metadata for rendering.

nodes.name: helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Small parsing helpers used by the event handler to preview partial streamed tool arguments and to parse hook script decisions.

nodes.name: tool_status_preview_from_args
nodes.summary: Produces a short human-readable preview string of a tool's arguments, such as a truncated file path or command, for live status display while the call streams in.

nodes.name: parse_partial_plan_args
nodes.summary: Attempts to parse a partially-streamed JSON buffer of a write-plan tool call into whatever plan fields are available so far.

nodes.name: decode_json_string_prefix
nodes.summary: Decodes a possibly-incomplete JSON string literal prefix, handling escapes, so partial streamed tool arguments can be previewed before the closing quote arrives.

nodes.name: parse_hook_decision
nodes.summary: Parses a hook script's stdout into a structured HookDecision (allow/deny/modify) governing whether a tool call proceeds.
